title: Robot Awaaz Nahi, Sirf Ek Akshar Sunta Hai 🤖 #shorts
description:
Phone se robot bina taar ke kaise chalta hai? Sirf ek akshar se, aur FC-51 IR sensor use deewar se bachata hai!
📱 Phone Bluetooth se sirf ek akshar (F, L, R) bhejta hai
🔌 HC-05 module use 9600 baud serial banata hai
💡 FC-51 IR sensor 940 nm ki infrared roshni se rukawat dekhta hai
🎚️ Neela pot 2 se 30 cm ki range set karta hai
Aise aur 3D explainers ke liye subscribe karo!
#shorts #arduino #bluetooth #robotics #hindi #electronics #stem
